records.claim: LEQVIO is contraindicated in patients with a prior serious hypersensitivity reaction to inclisiran or any of the excipients in LEQVIO. Serious hypersensitivity reactions have included anaphylaxis and angioedema [see Adverse Reactions (6.2)] . Prior serious hypersensitivity reaction to inclisiran or any of the excipients in LEQVIO.
